text_block_list.text:
The final race of the Classic Triple 
Crown, the Kikuka-sho. Amidst the cheers 
of the crowd boiling with anticipation for 
what drama awaits—

Symboli Rudolf stood there in quiet 
composure.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
It is commonly said that at the Kikuka 
Sho, the strongest Umamusume wins.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
A long haul of 3,000m, plus climbing the 
hill twice. There will be many situations 
that test your mental fortitude.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Therefore—speed, stamina, running 
technique. The "strong" Umamusume who 
possesses all of them will claim victory.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"If I were to surrender this crown to 
another Umamusume, I would not deserve to 
be called the 'Emperor.'"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
To express my gratitude for that trust, 
allow me to escort you.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
—To the distant heights, let us go 
together.
